name: 75069 · Mckinney, TX
findings: ZIP 75069 (Mckinney) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75069 (Mckinney) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75069 (Mckinney) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
